decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the About page prize-draw copy with the new Small and Big Block quantities and cadence.
The existing same-message MODIFY already updates both prize statements on the Mission page to the new quantities and cadence.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully captures the Small Block change to one $500 winner every 100 sales; no stale Small Block key requires removal.
Changing prize winner counts and draw cadence does not alter how the book, referral code, badges, or active and expired tickets behave on NFT transfer.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully captures the Big Block change to one $10,000 winner every 10,000 sales; no stale Big Block key requires removal.
The source explicitly preserves the same net giveaway amount and does not change the per-sale founder, commission, or prize-pool allocations.
The block-prize quantity and cadence adjustment does not change the $5 commission recipient rule for a mint without a referral code.
The source changes prize parameters only and does not alter the Project Rebuild or BooksOnChain branding rules.
The source does not resolve or modify whether prize awards use a one-click claim or automatic delivery, nor does it change the Winners page or claim URL.
Changing block-prize quantities and cadence does not alter the referral code's source, permanence, or display locations.
The source does not change fiat-user dashboard access or the wallet requirements for receiving commissions and holding prize tickets.
The source changes prize draws but does not modify the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, destination, limit, or expiration of code-based referral commissions.
